acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic regression reproduces the lost control, or the suspicion is closed with evidence.
A recorded drain or cancel is never silently overwritten.
body: Observed on branch claude/v1-0475-multi-repo (head e62e5bdb, base origin/main d524530f), Corvint 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Go 1.27.1, darwin/arm64, by the issue 354 lane. Suspected defect, not reproduced; the structure predates the branch. persist and the run journal callback copy the Control field from an unlocked read. A control recorded between that read and ProgramTransition own read is overwritten, and RequestProgramControl then reports control superseded. The CAL-V0-089 fence covers only a continuation first write. Expected: control fields are merged under the writer lock or the transition refuses on a changed control.

title: Suspected: persist and the run journal callback copy Control from an unlocked read, overwriting a newer control so RequestProgramControl reports control superseded
